variants.prompt: In a dimly lit boudoir, Ophelia reclines on a plush velvet chaise, clad in a sheer black negligee that clings to her curves. Soft candlelight casts a warm, inviting glow on her skin as she looks directly at the camera with a sultry, half-lidded gaze. Her tousled hair cascades over one shoulder, and a delicate silver choker rests against her slender neck. The intimate composition focuses attention on her alluring form, with the velvety drapes and antique furniture creating a sensual backdrop.
